name: reward-stem-bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating reward models on STEM problems: provides STEM question/answer pairs and/or model outputs and measures how well learned reward models rank or score answers consistent with reference solutions or human judgments. It is intended to assess reward-model alignment and calibration on technical question answering.
reputation: A niche dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing usage among researchers evaluating reward models on STEM tasks.
